info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Compliance By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows for the updating of compliance status related to financial accounting by specific parameters. Users can modify compliance details for various financial accounts identified by the given parameter. Typical consumers include financial institutions and regulatory bodies needing to ensure accurate compliance reporting. By facilitating timely updates, the API supports better risk management and adherence to financial regulations.

patch.summary: Update financial accounting details for compliance.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the financial accounting details associated with a specific compliance record. Ensure that you provide the necessary data in the request body to successfully patch the details of the financial account.
